body.message:
Hello,

We do not agree with the applied deductions.

The pest control report you provided clearly shows that the service was carried out on March 24, 2026, i.e. more than two weeks after our check-out date (March 6).

This confirms that the issue was not identified at the time of check-out and cannot be attributed to us.

Furthermore, no signed check-out inspection report indicating any pest issue or tenant liability has been provided.

An internal invoice does not constitute sufficient evidence of tenant responsibility.

Accordingly:
- The deduction for pest control is not justified
- The deduction for item removal has not been properly substantiated

As already stated in the DET complaint, we expect the full refund of AED 17,675.

Please confirm that the full amount will be transferred.

Thank you.
